message: Hi Alex, it's Priya at Ironside Auto Care, interesting. What does this cost?
reply: Hi Priya, thanks for getting back to me. It's a $900 one-time fix pack to address the issues we found on the Ironside Auto Care site. After that, an optional $250/month care plan covers ongoing updates and monitoring if you want it. No obligation either way. Happy to send the audit details if useful. Best, Alex
